faqs.title: Who owns the sunscreen?
faqs.answer: Whoever brought it. This makes it a shared service with no roadmap.

faqs.title: What is the dress code?
faqs.answer: Business casual, with an emphasis on casual and a minimum of one flower.

faqs.title: Will there be Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: At the pool, the lobby, and the pond. Coverage elsewhere is described as aspirational.

faqs.title: Do I need to open my laptop?
faqs.answer: No. Please bring it anyway, so it can feel included.

faqs.title: What should my out-of-office say?
faqs.answer: "Back Monday, fragrant." Edits are permitted, but fragrance is encouraged.
